y-m-82-07.material: Shaqada f(x)=|x| waa x marka x uu yahay 0 ama ka badan, iyo −x marka x uu ka yar yahay 0 (loo akhriyo: f ee x waa qiimaha saafiga ah ee x). Hel haddii soosaar jiro marka x=0. Si gooni ah u eeg dhinaca h ay togan tahay (midig) iyo dhinaca h ay taban tahay (bidix).

y-m-82-02.goal: Khibrad ka hel sida xeer laga sameeyey dhowr xog oo ugu horreeya xogta cusubi ugu tijaabiso, oo sheeg caddayn kee iyo ficillo xigta ee loo baahan yahay si 'loo xaqiijiyo' xeer.
y-m-82-02.material:
Dhig n bar wareeg, oo isku xidh lammaane kasta oo bar ah qayb xariijin ah. Dooro baraha si saddex qaybood aysan hal barta isugu kulmin (tusaale ahaan, xagal-xariijimaha lix-geesood joogto ah ma buuxiyaan, sababtoo ah saddex ayaa dhexda ku kulma). Ha noqdo R(n) tirada gobollada ay qaybahaasi u qaybiyaan gudaha wareegga.
Kuwa aan sawirka arki karin, halkan waa sharaxaad ereyo ah. Marka n=3, hal saddex-geeso ayaa samaysmaya, 1 gobol saddex-geesaha gudihiisa iyo 3 gobol saddex-geesaha dibaddiisa, sidaa darteed R(3)=4.
